name: Alice & Bob
description: Alice & Bob develops cat qubit quantum computers designed for fault-tolerant quantum computing. Their technology uses superconducting circuits with reduced error rates, aiming to build practical quantum computers that require fewer physical qubits for error correction.

products.name: Cat Qubit Processor
products.description: Superconducting quantum processor using cat qubits for inherent bit-flip error suppression

products.name: Felis Cloud Platform
products.description: Cloud-based access to cat qubit quantum computing for algorithm development and testing

highlights: Pioneered cat qubit technology that exponentially suppresses bit-flip errors
Raised over EUR 30M to build fault-tolerant quantum computers with fewer physical qubits
Spun out of ENS Paris and INRIA quantum research groups

news.title: Alice & Bob develops 'Elevator Codes' to slash error rates on cat-qubit systems
news.excerpt: New code family projects up to 10,000x lower logical error rates while requiring only roughly 3x more physical qubits.

news.title: Alice & Bob showcases cat-qubit fault-tolerance advances at APS Global Physics Summit
news.excerpt: More than a dozen talks covered cat-qubit stabilisation, intrinsic error protection and magic-state preparation.

news.title: Alice & Bob awarded $3.9M ARPA-E grant for rare-earth-free magnet design using quantum computing
news.excerpt: U.S. DOE ARPA-E QC³ programme awarded Alice & Bob and partners from Los Alamos National Laboratory and GE Vernova $3.9M to develop fault-tolerant quantum algorithms for discovering rare-earth-free permanent magnets.

news.title: Alice & Bob reaches 251 employees, completing hiring plan 30% ahead of schedule
news.excerpt: The company hired more than 100 employees in seven months, bringing headcount to 251 and completing its hiring plan well ahead of schedule.

news.title: Alice & Bob expands €100M Series B with strategic investment from NVIDIA's NVentures arm
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob extended its Series B with an undisclosed investment from NVentures, NVIDIA's venture arm, deepening technical collaboration that spans CUDA-Q, cuQuantum, and Dynamiqs — Alice & Bob's open-source quantum simulation library.

news.title: Alice & Bob unveils Helium, its first complete on-premise cat-qubit quantum system
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob unveiled the Helium Quantum System on June 10, 2026, marking the company's first move beyond developing chips to delivering a full quantum computing system for on-premise deployment. Helium encodes Alice & Bob's first logical qubit with as few as 18 cat qubits.

news.title: France acquires Alice & Bob Helium cat-qubit system for national HPC research infrastructure
news.excerpt: GENCI and Alice & Bob signed an agreement for France to acquire an 18-cat-qubit Helium quantum computer — the world's first deployment of a cat-qubit system. The machine will be installed at the TGCC and integrated with the Joliot-Curie supercomputer, with user access expected in 2027.
